question: How many tracks are in the store in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track;

question: List all music genres available, alphabetically.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name;

question: How many customers are from Canada?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada';

question: Which sales support employee has generated the highest total sales, and what is the amount?
sql: SELECT E.FirstName || ' ' || E.LastName AS EmployeeName, SUM(I.Total) AS TotalSales FROM Employee E JOIN Customer C ON E.EmployeeId = C.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId GROUP BY E.EmployeeId ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 1;

question: For genres with more than 100 tracks, what is the average track length in minutes for each?
sql: SELECT G.Name AS GenreName, AVG(T.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS AvgMinutes FROM Track T JOIN Genre G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId GROUP BY G.GenreId HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ORDER BY G.Name;

question: List any customers who have never made a purchase (no invoices at all).
sql: SELECT C.CustomerId, C.FirstName, C.LastName FROM Customer C LEFT JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId WHERE I.InvoiceId IS NULL;

question: Which 3 artists have sold the most tracks in total by quantity, and how many units did each sell?
sql: SELECT T.Composer AS ArtistName, SUM(IL.Quantity) AS TotalSold FROM InvoiceLine IL JOIN Track T ON IL.TrackId = T.TrackId GROUP BY T.Composer ORDER BY TotalSold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which artist has released the most albums?
sql: SELECT Ar.Name AS ArtistName FROM Artist Ar JOIN Album Al ON Ar.ArtistId = Al.ArtistId GROUP BY Ar.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent, and how much did each spend?
sql: SELECT C.FirstName || ' ' || C.LastName AS CustomerName, SUM(I.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer C JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId GROUP BY C.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What is the average invoice total for customers located in the USA?
sql: SELECT AVG(I.Total) AS AvgTotal FROM Customer C JOIN Invoice I ON C.CustomerId = I.CustomerId WHERE C.Country = 'USA';

question: How many tracks belong to the 'Rock' genre?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Track T JOIN Genre G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId WHERE G.Name = 'Rock';

question: Which playlist has the most tracks, and how many tracks is that?
sql: SELECT P.Name AS PlaylistName, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount FROM Playlist P JOIN PlaylistTrack PT ON P.PlaylistId = PT.PlaylistId GROUP BY P.PlaylistId ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What was the total revenue generated in the year 2010?
sql: SELECT SUM(Total) AS TotalRevenue FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2010';
